verdict: Google Business profile stalled this week; no paid ads are running.
narrative: This period, your practice ran no paid advertising on Meta or Google Ads, so all activity came through your Google Business Profile and organic website traffic. Your profile delivered 42 actions over the 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — but came to a near-complete stop in the last several days, producing a 93.75% drop in profile actions week over week. Website sessions are actually up 13.5% this week, which is a positive sign, though conversion tracking appears to have a gap and is being repaired so that visitor-to-inquiry numbers can be measured accurately. Once tracking is confirmed, we will have a clear read on whether site visitors are reaching out.
